title: Image Prompts for Batch Guardrails Articles

prompts.prompt: Modern minimalist line art illustration, 16:9 aspect ratio. A simple, elegant depiction of [THEOLOGICAL CONCEPT] - [VISUAL DESCRIPTION]. Clean line work, minimal detail, focusing on [KEY THEME]. Very simplistic, even line art style, modern aesthetic. No text, no words, no typography.

structure.filename: Format: '##_Topic_Name.png' where ## is zero-padded number (01, 02, etc.) and Topic_Name uses underscores between words
structure.topic: Full topic name with proper capitalization and spacing
structure.prompt: Image generation prompt following the pattern below

prompt_pattern.opening: Modern minimalist line art illustration, 16:9 aspect ratio.
prompt_pattern.description: A simple, elegant depiction of [THEOLOGICAL CONCEPT] - [VISUAL DESCRIPTION].
prompt_pattern.style_notes: Clean line work, minimal detail, focusing on [KEY THEME].
prompt_pattern.closing: Very simplistic, even line art style, modern aesthetic. No text, no words, no typography.

prompt_components.THEOLOGICAL_CONCEPT: The biblical/Christian truth being illustrated (e.g., 'Jesus Christ as the exclusive way', 'divine creation and supernatural reality', 'the authority of God's Word')
prompt_components.VISUAL_DESCRIPTION: Specific visual elements to include (e.g., 'a single path leading upward, with a cross at the top', 'a hand reaching down from above with light rays breaking through', 'an open Bible with light emanating from its pages')
prompt_components.KEY_THEME: The main focus or message (e.g., 'the lordship of Jesus', 'the reality of the supernatural realm', 'the truth and authority of Scripture')

example_usage.step_1: Identify the theological concept or biblical truth related to the guardrail topic
example_usage.step_2: Design a simple visual metaphor that represents this truth
example_usage.step_3: Fill in the template with: [THEOLOGICAL CONCEPT], [VISUAL DESCRIPTION], and [KEY THEME]
example_usage.step_4: Ensure the prompt emphasizes: simplicity, minimalism, no text, 16:9 aspect ratio, modern aesthetic
